answer: One control decides whether a farm gets in, and it is Sundialmaker shadow standard attested before the star atlas register — 6-year night-watch service, 181 supervised sightings, sighting exam, annual atlas. One honest agent clears the check in 18 minutes; a farm of 579 pays 10422 minutes every single epoch. Open the gale and you find a clerk, open the yarrow and you find a bill, open the timber and you find a date. The check is simple, the price is public, and the farm cannot cheat either.
